instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot capturing an indoor motion capture studio with white walls and a red carpet. On the left, the bearded man in a black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right. On the right, the woman in a white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left, reaching her right hand forward to touch his left shoulder. The background features a dark red partition screen and office equipment. The overhead indoor lighting casts soft shadows on the red carpet, creating a neutral, functional atmosphere.
elements: R2 reaches her right hand forward to touch R1's left shoulder
R1 receives the shoulder touch from R2 rather than touching R2
R2 is the active toucher and R1 is the touched partner
R1 and R2 stand facing each other during the shoulder contact
the interaction takes place in an indoor motion capture studio

questions.q: Is R2 the one extending her right hand to touch R1's left shoulder, rather than R1 extending a hand to touch R2's shoulder?
Is R1 the person receiving the shoulder touch from R2, rather than R2 receiving a shoulder touch from R1?
questions.element: R1 is the touched partner while R2 initiates contact

questions.q: Does the contact occur with R2's hand on R1's left shoulder, rather than with R1's hand on R2's shoulder?
questions.element: contact point is R1's shoulder touched by R2's hand

questions.q: Is R2 reaching forward with her right hand while R1 stands as the partner being touched?
questions.element: R2 reaches forward and R1 is the recipient
